title: Social Commitments in Distributed Systems: TikTok Creator Campaign
shortDescription: Explore a playable TikTok-style video feed and build an event-driven Python multi-agent simulator with delays, retries, and commitment verification.
learningOutcomes: Analyze goals, social commitments, and dependencies among independent agents.
Implement event-driven handlers that emit new messages for creator, brand, compliance, and payment services.
Process at-least-once messages with event IDs, deterministic event order, and idempotency.
Implement conditional commitment lifecycles and deadline verification.
Inject faults and interpret delivery delays, compliance failures, payment retries, and missed obligations.

courseAlignment.evidence: Analyze distributed coordination and commitment responsibilities.
Implement state transitions and test agent behavior.

tasks.title: Explore the video feed and campaign
tasks.description: Scroll through the playable clips and identify the creator, brand, compliance, and payment agents.

tasks.title: Trace the five commitments
tasks.description: Inspect the trigger, debtor, creditor, promised outcome, and deadline for K1–K5.

tasks.title: Run the starting simulator
tasks.description: Run main.py and inspect the six supplied scenarios and five agent-generated experiments.

tasks.title: Implement the commitment engine
tasks.description: Enforce legal offers, deduplicate events, and evaluate conditional commitments from deadlines.

tasks.title: Program autonomous agents
tasks.description: Write agent_reactions() so the four services react to events and publish follow-up events.

tasks.title: Generate agent campaigns
tasks.description: Test normal delivery, late delivery, payment retries, outages, and compliance rejection.

tasks.title: Inject faults and measure outcomes
tasks.description: Change policy values, rerun Python, and explain what changed in the generated event log.

tasks.title: Verify and report
tasks.description: Run all seven behavior tests and complete the five evidence-based report questions.
